visualBaseline: Kitchen V6 Option B plus Frank-approved 2026-10-16 wall-anchored reference study

wallAnchoring.placementRule: Every back-wall asset is positioned by its bottom-centre anchor at y=52 lp; this is a room transform, not a rescale or sprite crop.

countertopRepair.surfaceRule: Every exposed countertop wing is continuously opaque from the outer edge to the appliance silhouette; no chips, notches, bites, V-gaps or stepped holes.

acceptanceRules: The corrected worktop wings are continuously opaque and smooth with no missing surface pixels.
The fridge has no brown pixels in its top region and reads as a bright-white freestanding appliance.
Every pedal-bin state stays within a 10 by 12 logical-pixel opaque envelope.
Every back-wall asset uses the 52-lp foot line, leaving 4 lp of foreground floor visible.
The porthole frame is 19 lp wide, remains inside one bay, and has a genuinely transparent aperture.
Weather and time imagery is stored separately from the porthole frame and may be swapped without changing the frame bytes.
The porthole frame, weather underlay and sink receive identical horizontal translation.
Kitchen V6, Kitchen Room V7, Keeper art, runtime sprites, Final art and manifests remain byte-identical.
